items.html: And after their being clothed, they are included; it is found that since these are the aspect of the ChGT, they gave power in the ChGT of the externality, which are the ChGT that are in the NHY, and they also grew in the externality. And it is now found that it has two aspects of ZA: the middle and the external. However, the external is now growing a second growth, namely that the ChGT within it grew, in this manner: Chesed in Netzach, Chesed in Chesed, Chesed in Chokhma; Gevura in Hod, Gevura in Gevura, Gevura in Bina; Tifferet in Yesod, Tifferet in Tifferet, Tifferet in Daat.
